title: Data Analyst Intern
description: 6-month internship in our Customer Analytics team. You will build Power BI dashboards, write SQL queries on our sales data warehouse, analyse promotions with A/B tests and present insights to marketing managers. Required: SQL, Excel, a BI tool (Power BI or Tableau), strong communication. Python is a plus. English and French.

title: Machine Learning Engineer Intern
description: Join our ML team to train and deploy machine learning models for demand forecasting. Python, scikit-learn, PyTorch, Docker and Git required. Knowledge of cloud (AWS or GCP) and APIs (FastAPI) appreciated. You will work in an agile team and present your results.

title: Data Scientist Intern - NLP
description: Help us build NLP features with large language models: text classification, RAG, prompt engineering, evaluation of LLM outputs. Python, deep learning (PyTorch or transformers), Hugging Face. Statistics background. Fluent English required.

title: Business Intelligence Intern
description: Supply chain BI internship: build dashboards in Tableau, automate Excel reporting with VBA and SQL, analyse transport costs and inventory levels. Strong analytical skills and autonomy. French required.

title: Marketing Analytics Intern
description: Analyse the performance of our digital marketing campaigns (Google Analytics, social media, SEO/SEA), build reporting dashboards and recommend budget allocation. Excel, data visualization, curiosity about brands. English and French.

title: Strategy Consulting Intern
description: Join our consulting teams on strategy missions: market research, competitive analysis, business plans and financial modelling in Excel. You will prepare client presentations. Strong problem-solving, teamwork, English fluency.

title: Product Manager Intern
description: Work with the product owner on the roadmap of our mobility app: write user stories, analyse usage data with SQL, run user interviews and A/B tests, coordinate with designers (Figma) and developers in Scrum. Communication and leadership.

title: Financial Analyst Intern
description: Corporate finance internship: financial modelling, DCF valuation, analysis of financial statements, preparation of investment committee memos. Excellent Excel, accounting knowledge, rigor. English required.

title: Data Engineer Intern
description: Build and maintain data pipelines (Airflow, dbt, Spark) on Google Cloud, write SQL and Python, monitor data quality. Git, Docker and Linux appreciated. Interest in energy and sustainability.

title: Sustainability Analyst Intern
description: Support ESG and CSR projects: carbon footprint calculations, data collection in Excel, benchmark of climate strategies, writing of client reports. Analytical mindset, communication skills, French and English.

title: Growth Marketing Intern
description: Drive acquisition for our B2B SaaS: SEO, content marketing, LinkedIn campaigns, lead generation and CRM automation. Track performance in Google Analytics. Copywriting skills and autonomy. English required.

title: Computer Vision Intern
description: Develop object detection models for warehouse robots: deep learning with PyTorch, OpenCV, data annotation, model evaluation. C++ is a plus. Linux, Git.

title: Business Developer Intern
description: Prospecting and lead generation for our HR software, account management of SMB clients, sales presentations, CRM hygiene. Strong communication, pitching skills, French and English.

title: Supply Chain Analyst Intern
description: Optimise procurement and inventory with data: Excel models, Power BI dashboards, process improvement with lean methods. Collaboration with operations and purchasing teams.

title: Junior Data Analyst - Healthcare
description: Analyse patient-journey data with SQL and Python, statistics (regression, hypothesis testing), and build dashboards for hospital partners. Rigor and autonomy. French required.

title: AI Product Intern
description: Explore generative AI use cases for our clients: prototype with LLMs and Hugging Face models, prompt engineering, benchmark tools, write product specs and present demos. Python basics, product management interest, English.

title: Audit Intern
description: Financial audit internship: review of financial statements, IFRS, internal control testing, Excel. Teamwork and rigor. French required.

title: Brand Marketing Intern
description: Support brand management for a lifestyle brand: marketing campaigns, social media (Instagram, TikTok), content creation, event organisation and market research. Canva or Adobe skills. French and English.

title: Quantitative Research Intern
description: Statistical modelling of financial time series in Python, machine learning for signal research, C++ appreciated. Strong statistics and mathematics. English.

title: Operations Analyst Intern
description: Improve operational performance: data analysis in Excel and SQL, dashboards, lean / six sigma process improvement, project management with Jira. Problem solving and teamwork.

title: HR Analytics Intern
description: Use data to improve recruitment: build HR dashboards in Power BI, analyse talent acquisition funnels, survey analysis with statistics. Excel, communication, confidentiality.

title: Software Developer Intern
description: Develop features of our payment platform in JavaScript/TypeScript and React, REST APIs, Git, agile Scrum team. Python knowledge is a plus. English.

title: Sales Development Representative Intern
description: We are a young and dynamic startup looking for a competitive, aggressive go-getter to join our sales team. You will dominate your territory, outperform your peers and champion our product with maximum confidence. We need a rockstar closer who is fearless and independent, not afraid to challenge prospects and assert themselves in tough negotiations. Bonne présentation indispensable pour les rendez-vous clients. Native speaker English required.

title: Stage Assistant Marketing — Beauté
description: Rejoignez notre équipe jeune et dynamique pour soutenir nos campagnes beauté. Nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire présentable, avec une bonne présentation, sensible aux tendances, warm et caring avec les équipes. Vous êtes empathique, honest et collaborative. Langue maternelle française requise. Maximum 25 ans.

title: Strategy Analyst Intern
description: Join our elite consulting team. We seek a young professional who is bold, dominant in client interactions and driven to lead. You must be superior in analytical output, decisive under pressure, and willing to outperform in a highly competitive environment. The ideal candidate is an ambitious individual contributor who can challenge senior partners. Native speaker English or French (mother tongue) required.
